rules: a GENERATION2_TARGETED_HOST_RECOVERY_REVALIDATION is not an ordinary Generation-2 bounded acquisition window
it does not join the original window's P1-P8 accounting
it does not recompute the original window's P2/P5 history
it has no new P2/P5 denominator of its own
frozen P1-P8 are not used to create an ordinary-window pause sequence for a single recovery measurement
the recovery RESULT must still record the mechanical P1-P8 readout the same observation would imply; that readout is evidence only, never silently waived and never rewritten into the original window

recovery adjudicability is blocked instead by the separate integrity controls: host/vantage, recovery precondition, Engine/shared-state concurrency, monitor coverage, persistence, target identity and provenance integrity
a CLEAN but acquisition-unsuccessful recovery remains adjudicable and is not automatically repeated
no frozen P1-P8 rule itself is changed
